info.name: Task 5 - API Testing and Validation
info.description: Postman collection for testing the Flask-based MNIST deep learning API.

exec: pm.test("Response status is success", function () { const data = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(data.status).to.eql("success"); });
pm.test("Health message is returned", function () { const data = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(data.message).to.include("API is running"); });
pm.test("Response status is success", function () { const data = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(data.status).to.eql("success"); });
